description: GENERIC Pre-Ship Human Review Panel section template — customizable seed transplanted to external projects by transplant-bundle (git-worktree-isolation). Opt-in: honoured only when `override` is true (this seed ships false, so an untouched seed never freezes the built-in panel or goes stale). When opted in it is read on the live path by .cli/lib/worktree-ship-report.mjs#loadReviewPanelConfig (pre-ship-review-guard, worktree-shipping-guard, the pre-ship step runner and the ship-worktree completion report); absent or malformed keys fall back to the built-in DEFAULT_REVIEW_SECTIONS / DEFAULT_REPORT_LABELS / APPROVAL_CHOICES. harness itself ships no copy of this file, so its own output is the built-in English. The `sections` array follows the same schema as .cli/lib/section-template-renderer.mjs#renderTemplateFromSections (5 block types: static/checklist_group/field_list/fenced_block/table). Identical content to DEFAULT_REVIEW_SECTIONS (locked by drift regression test in tests/unit/worktree-ship-report.test.mjs) — target projects may freely adjust sections, copy, or table columns after transplant while preserving the renderer contract.

sections.heading: ## 0. Decision Summary (Must be actionable from these 6 lines alone)

lines: The following worktree work is complete.
Please review the details and approve whether to proceed with merge / cleanup.
- AI interpretation (goal / scope / assumptions — task-interpretation.mjs record):
- Gap verdict: match | drift (built something else) | creep (built more than asked) | narrowing (asked but missing)
- Deliberately NOT done, and why (negative space a diff cannot show):

sections.heading: ## 3. Review Attention Budget (Where a human should spend eyes first)

lines: - Read first (max 3, file:line + why it decides approval):
- Lowest-confidence spot (AI self-assessed) + what would settle it:
- If this breaks in production, it breaks here first:
- Changed but covered by neither a test nor a human read:
- Changed but not covered by any test, and why that is acceptable:

header_lines: Path               Type    Role    Reason for Change
blocks.row_template: {path}    {kind}    Fill during review    Fill during review

sections.heading: ## 10. Contract / Blast Radius (answer no, or yes → note)

lines: - SSOT registry touched (data/registry/**) → which derived views were regenerated:
- Schema touched (data/schemas/**) → do existing artifacts still validate:
- Hook registration touched (hook-registry.mjs) → was regen-hooks-settings.mjs run:
- Exported / public interface changed → were all call sites updated:
- Scaffold template touched (project-scaffolder/templates/**) → R-CM-028 boundary verdict:

sections.heading: ## 14. Remaining Work & Follow-ups (every item carries a priority)

lines: - P0 — must be resolved BEFORE this ship. Do not request approval while any P0 stands: none | <item>
- Registered as debt (R-CM-033): <DEBT-ids> | not required (no P1/P2 items)

sections.heading: ## 15. Issues and Improvements Observed (every item carries a severity)

lines: - Severity scale: CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW (same enum as followup-debt.schema.json#severity)
- Issues encountered: none | <SEVERITY> <what happened> → <resolved how, or still open>
- Improvement proposals: none | <SEVERITY> <proposal> → <where it belongs: rule | hook | script | doc>
- Recurrence prevention: <mechanism added, file:line> | none (state why prompt-level suffices)

_adapt.purpose: External project adaptation guide (harness code does not read this key — guidance only).
_adapt.how: Number of sections (harness convention is 16) is not mandatory — feel free to add or remove headings/blocks. Values in field_list are always treated with valueOrDash (empty value -> '-'). table's row_template substitutes `{key}` placeholders with corresponding fields from each object in rows_key array.
_adapt.wiring: Set `override` to true after editing — without it the file is ignored (a one-line hint is shown if its sections differ from the built-in). No other wiring needed: the ship guards, the step runner and the completion report read this file from the main repository root. The transplant preserves an edited copy on re-transplant (extra_files are customizable).
_adapt.localize: Optional top-level keys besides `sections`: `locale` (tag, e.g. "ko"), `labels` (any subset of .cli/lib/worktree-ship-report.mjs#DEFAULT_REPORT_LABELS — completion report headings/fields, panel placeholders, PLAN checklist status; `{name}` placeholders are filled at render time), `approval_choices` ({approve, revise, abort} — shown in the panel and runner, and accepted verbatim by the parser alongside the built-in multilingual stems), `line_budget` (positive integer; an over-budget panel gets a one-line notice). Section static lines may interpolate {{approvalChoices}}, {{approveChoice}}, {{reviseChoice}}, {{abortChoice}}, {{severityScale}}; field_list may use key `changedSummary` (one-line file count by kind). The deck is localized separately via `.claude/reach-map.json` (`locale`, `tiers.<id>`).
